PZZ700-100415-
825 AM PDT Fri Oct 9 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...At 1 AM, a 1026 mb high
was about 590 nautical miles west of Medford Oregon, and a 1008 
mb low was over eastern Riverside County. Tropical Storm Rachel
was about 850 nautical miles west of Cabo San Lucas with a 
central pressure of 987 mb. Weak northwest winds will prevail 
through Saturday. The remnants of Rachel will bring an increase 
in southerly swell along with stronger, gusty winds and choppy 
seas Sunday. Winds and seas subside somewhat on Monday. More 
typical onshore flow returns by Tuesday.

$$
